name: restart
description: Dispatch the run's `restart` intent and confirm a fresh run came back up.
note: This is a FORMAT SEED, not a real test of your game — there is no mechanic here yet to test. Keep it (restart stays worth proving after a scene reload) and add a routine per mechanic next to it: run one with game_run {routine:'<name>'}. Steps are the game_input vocabulary plus {type:'command'} for a registered intent; `expect` holds the ordinary game_run predicates, ANDed and judged once after the last step against the frame pair around the run. Only a STEP takes a `why`. Prefer a `gameState` predicate over a node one wherever GameRules already publishes the value — it survives every relayout of the HUD.

steps.name: restart
steps.why: The intent RETRY dispatches, taken at the highest channel: it proves the wire without depending on where the button sits, and the dispatch is journalled with the frame it happened on.
